adjudication.rationale: In `spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb`, the prior `.update` specs that exercised updating a normal (non-automatic) group (including setting `name` and `usernames`) were removed, and the new `.update` context only tests the automatic-group rename-ignore behavior (`xhr :put, :update, id: 1, name: "WAT", visible: "true"`). Meanwhile `Admin::GroupsController#update` was rewritten to read flat params (`params[:alias_level]`, `params[:visible]`, `params[:name]`) and to allow renaming only when `!group.automatic`. There is no spec covering the happy path for a non-automatic group persisting `name`, `alias_level`, and `visible`, so a regression in this primary save path could slip through with a green suite.
